instruction: `reverse_words` in `textutils/words.py` reverses the characters of the whole string instead of reversing the order of whitespace-separated words. For input `hello world` it returns `dlrow olleh` instead of `world hello`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/words.py b/textutils/words.py
--- a/textutils/words.py
+++ b/textutils/words.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
     single spaces and surrounding whitespace is stripped.
     """
     words = split_words(text)
-    return text[::-1]
+    return " ".join(reversed(words))
